lineage_stages.description: Pre-draft Scouting Combine tables (`combine_results.csv`, `combine_tracking.csv`), master entities (`players.csv`, `games.csv`), play participation (`player_play.csv`), 3 seasons of 10 Hz Next Gen Stats tracking (`game_tracking_2023/2024/2025.csv`), and career benchmarks (`player_career_successes.csv`).

Standardize `playDirection` in game tracking (`x`, `y`, `o`, `dir`), unwrap circular orientation angles (`o`, `dir`) across 0°/360°, verify uniform 0.1s (`10 Hz`) frame deltas, and filter position groups (WR, TE, DB, OL, DL).

Aggregate 10 Hz frame trajectories to the `(nflId, drillType)` grain for Combine tracking and `(gameId, playId, nflId)` grain for regular-season tracking BEFORE joining across domains, preventing many-to-many row multiplication.

Join player-level Combine sensor features (`nflId`) with `combine_results.csv`, season-aggregated play outcomes, and `player_career_successes.csv` to evaluate Research Questions RQ-01 through RQ-05 with draft-cohort cross-validation.
